name: image-toolkit
description: Image create & edit framework — three AI providers for generation and semantic editing (Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI gpt-image-2, Azure FLUX.2), plus ImageMagick 7 for fast local processing (resize, crop, convert, watermark, favicon, batch, GIF, montage). Bundled generate_image.py runs via uv (no manual deps). Generic: prompts and assets come from the user, all credentials and endpoints from the environment. Command: /image
